svg.title: Cumulative workload demand and recorded capacity

cc:Work.dc:title: Cumulative workload demand and recorded capacity
cc:Work.dc:description: Two engine-derived scenarios show a 60-minute noon deficit, later equality, and conservative/optimistic capacity when an exam end is unknown. Synthetic inputs only.
